election.name: Illinois General Primary Election
election.note: Voters must declare a party (Democratic or Republican) to receive a partisan ballot. An independent ballot contains only referenda.

races.title: U.S. Senate
races.description: Illinois voters will elect one member to the U.S. Senate. This seat was held by Dick Durbin since 1997; Durbin declined to seek a sixth term. The primary winner will face the opposite party's nominee in the November 3, 2026 general election.

candidates.name: Raja Krishnamoorthi
candidates.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 8th Congressional District since 2017. Krishnamoorthi earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering and public policy from Princeton (1995) and a J.D. from Harvard Law (2000). He previously worked as an attorney, small-business owner, law clerk, and deputy Illinois State Treasurer.
priorities: Reining in abuses of executive power
endorsements: Former Obama chief of staff Bill Daley

candidates.name: Robin Kelly
candidates.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 2nd Congressional District since 2013. Kelly previously served in the Illinois House, as chief of staff to Illinois Treasurer Alexi Giannoulias, and as Cook County Board President Toni Preckwinkle's chief administrative officer. She lives in south suburban Matteson.

candidates.name: Juliana Stratton
candidates.bio: Lieutenant Governor of Illinois since 2019. Stratton served one term in the Illinois House before becoming lieutenant governor. She was the first candidate to announce after Durbin's retirement and immediately received the endorsement of Governor JB Pritzker.
priorities: Tax cuts for middle class funded by millionaire tax

candidates.name: Steve Botsford Jr.
candidates.bio: Grew up in the northwest suburbs of Illinois and graduated from Notre Dame, where he walked on to the football team. After college, he worked on Capitol Hill for Congressman Tony Cárdenas drafting legislation on economic mobility and workforce issues. He later earned a master's in applied economics from Georgetown and an MBA from Northwestern.

candidates.name: Awisi A. Bustos
candidates.bio: Nonprofit executive and first-generation Ghanaian American. Previously served as CEO of the Illinois Alliance of Boys & Girls Clubs, overseeing an $11 million budget.
priorities: Restoring integrity and justice to public service

candidates.name: Jonathan Dean
candidates.bio: Activist, entrepreneur, and litigator who describes himself as 'a proud survivor of childhood sexual abuse.' He says Illinois needs a senator who will fight for young people and working families and stand against fascism.

candidates.name: Bryan Maxwell
candidates.bio: Assistant research scientist and project engineer at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. Has spent the last two years organizing against U.S. military aid to Israel.
priorities: Redirecting military spending to local communities

candidates.name: Sean Brown
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Kevin Ryan
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Christopher Swann
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Don Tracy
candidates.bio: Attorney, former chairman of the Illinois Republican Party, and former chairman of the Illinois Gaming Board. Tracy argues that when Durbin retires, all statewide elected officials will reside in Chicago or Cook County, leaving the other 101 counties without representation.

candidates.name: R. Cary Capparelli
candidates.bio: International businessman and educator. Son of the late Ralph C. Capparelli, who served 17 consecutive terms as a moderate Democrat in the Illinois House. Cary's career spanned the globe, including organizing the first motorsports competitions between the U.S. and the former Soviet Union.

candidates.name: Pamela Denise Long
candidates.bio: Occupational therapist and political commentator.
priorities: Replacing income tax with a consumption tax

candidates.name: Casey Chlebek
candidates.bio: Polish immigrant who has lived in the U.S. since the 1960s and is a longtime IT professional.
priorities: Investing in robotics, AI, and quantum computing

candidates.name: Jeannie Evans
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Jimmy Lee Tillman II
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Max Rice
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Austin Mink
candidates.bio: Running as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Tyrone Muhammad
candidates.bio: Running as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate.

candidates.name: Anthony Smith
candidates.bio: Running as an independent candidate for U.S. Senate.

races.title: Governor / Lieutenant Governor
races.description: Illinois voters will elect a Governor and Lieutenant Governor (who run on a joint ticket) for a four-year term. The primary winner faces the opposite party nominee in the November 3, 2026 general election.

candidates.name: J.B. Pritzker / Christian Mitchell
candidates.bio: J.B. Pritzker has served as Governor of Illinois since 2019. If re-elected, he would be the first Democratic governor to secure a third term in Illinois history. Running mate Christian Mitchell served as deputy governor (2019–2023) and as a state representative (2013–2019).

candidates.name: Darren Bailey / Aaron Del Mar
candidates.bio: Darren Bailey is a former state senator and farmer from downstate Illinois who lost to Pritzker in the 2022 gubernatorial race. Running mate Aaron Del Mar is a rising Republican figure in Cook County, selected to improve the ticket's appeal in the Chicago area.

candidates.name: James Mendrick / Running Mate TBD
candidates.bio: DuPage County Sheriff since 2018. Mendrick has partnered with the DuPage County Health Department to provide Medication-Assisted Treatment to inmates fighting opioid addiction.

candidates.name: Ted Dabrowski / Carrie Mendoza
candidates.bio: Ted Dabrowski is the president of a conservative news and policy website. Running mate Carrie Mendoza is the leader of FAIR In Medicine.

candidates.name: Rick Heidner / Running Mate TBD
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Governor of Illinois.

races.title: U.S. House – Illinois 9th Congressional District
races.description: Rep. Jan Schakowsky (D) is retiring after holding this seat since 1998. The district covers the Far North Side of Chicago (including West Ridge, Rogers Park, and Edgewater) and extends northwest to include parts of Lake and McHenry counties. This heavily Democratic district is effectively decided in the primary.

candidates.name: Daniel Biss
candidates.bio: Mayor of Evanston since 2021. Biss previously served as a state senator (2013–2019) and state representative (2011–2013) in the district, and ran for governor in 2018, finishing second in the Democratic primary behind JB Pritzker.

candidates.name: Kat Abughazaleh
candidates.bio: Researcher and journalist known for video explainers debunking Fox News and right-wing media, having worked for Media Matters, Mother Jones, and Zeteo News. Her grandparents were survivors of the 1948 Palestinian mass displacement and immigrated to Chicago. Moved to Illinois in 2024.

candidates.name: Laura Fine
candidates.bio: Illinois State Senator representing parts of the Far North Side and north suburbs since 2018. Previously a state representative (2013–2019) for the 17th district. Her candidacy has drawn controversy due to campaign contributions from donors affiliated with AIPAC.

candidates.name: Mike Simmons
candidates.bio: Illinois State Senator — the first openly gay member of the Illinois Senate. His candidacy focuses on lived experience with poverty and housing insecurity.

candidates.name: Bushra Amiwala
candidates.bio: 28-year-old Skokie School District 73.5 board member. She has protested at the Broadview immigration detention center and was tear-gassed by ICE agents in September 2025.

candidates.name: Rocio Cleveland
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District.

candidates.name: John Elleson
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Paul Friedman
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Mark Su
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 9th Congressional District.

races.title: U.S. House – Illinois 7th Congressional District
races.description: Rep. Danny Davis (D) is retiring after 15 consecutive terms. The district covers Chicago's West Side, Downtown, the South Loop, parts of the South Side, and suburban communities including Oak Park, Maywood, and Forest Park. This heavily Democratic district is effectively decided in the primary.

candidates.name: La Shawn Ford
candidates.bio: West Side State Representative since 2007. Ford ran for Chicago mayor in 2019. He is the candidate endorsed by retiring Rep. Danny Davis.

candidates.name: Melissa Conyears-Ervin
candidates.bio: Chicago City Treasurer serving her second term, formerly a state representative. She finished as runner-up to Davis in the 2024 Democratic primary.

candidates.name: Kina Collins
candidates.bio: Progressive organizer from Chicago's Austin neighborhood running for the 4th time since 2018. Former executive director of One Aim Illinois, the state's largest gun violence prevention nonprofit.

candidates.name: Jason Friedman
candidates.bio: Owner and former president of Friedman Properties, a major River North real estate firm. Previously worked under Rahm Emanuel in the Clinton administration.

candidates.name: Richard Boykin
candidates.bio: Lawyer who served on the Cook County Board of Commissioners (2014–2018) and previously worked as Rep. Danny Davis's chief of staff.

candidates.name: Anthony Driver
candidates.bio: Executive director of the Service Employees International Union (SEIU) Illinois State Council. Was the first president of the Community Commission for Public Safety and Accountability.

candidates.name: Thomas Fisher
candidates.bio: Emergency physician at the University of Chicago Medical Center. Served as a White House Fellow under President Obama during the rollout of the Affordable Care Act.

candidates.name: David Ehrlich
candidates.bio: Adjunct lecturer at UIC's College of Urban Planning and Public Affairs. Previously a senior analyst for the U.S. Government Accountability Office.

candidates.name: Anabel Mendoza
candidates.bio: At 27, the youngest candidate in the race. Immigrant rights organizer with the youth-led nonprofit United We Dream.

candidates.name: Rory Hoskins
candidates.bio: First Black mayor of Forest Park, serving his second term after two terms as a commissioner.

candidates.name: Reed Showalter
candidates.bio: Former Federal Trade Commission attorney, Department of Justice counsel, and White House National Economic Council adviser. Left federal service in protest of Trump administration policies.

candidates.name: Jazmin Robinson
candidates.bio: Corporate human resources worker and improv performer. Running to end big-money influence in politics.

candidates.name: Felix Tello
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois' 7th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Chad Koppie
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 7th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Patricia 'P Rae' Easley
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 7th Congressional District.

races.title: U.S. House – Illinois 8th Congressional District
races.description: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi is giving up this seat to run for U.S. Senate, making it open for the first time in a decade. The district includes the Far Northwest Side of Chicago near O'Hare Airport and northwest suburbs including Schaumburg, Hoffman Estates, Elgin, and Geneva.

candidates.name: Melissa Bean
candidates.bio: Former three-term U.S. Representative for the 8th District before losing to conservative Joe Walsh in 2010. Since leaving Congress she has held senior private-sector roles, most recently as CEO of Mesirow's Wealth Management and previously as Chairman of JPMorgan Chase's Midwest operations.

candidates.name: Junaid Ahmed
candidates.bio: Tech entrepreneur who unsuccessfully challenged Krishnamoorthi in the 2022 primary. Refuses to take any PAC contributions. Considers himself the most progressive candidate in the race, influenced by Bernie Sanders.

candidates.name: Yasmeen Bankole
candidates.bio: Hanover Park village trustee who has worked for both Rep. Krishnamoorthi and Sen. Dick Durbin.

candidates.name: Sanjyot Dunung
candidates.bio: Runs a global education company. Served on a foreign policy working group under President Biden.

candidates.name: Neil Khot
candidates.bio: Tech services business owner and first-generation Indian immigrant.

candidates.name: Kevin Morrison
candidates.bio: Two-term Cook County Commissioner and the first openly gay member of the Cook County Board.

candidates.name: Dan Tully
candidates.bio: Former judge advocate in the U.S. Army Reserve and foreign assistance worker for the Department of Commerce. Left federal service in protest of Trump administration policies.

candidates.name: Ryan Vetticad
candidates.bio: Refuses to take PAC money. Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois' 8th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Kevin Ake
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 8th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Jennifer Davis
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 8th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Herbert Hebein
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 8th Congressional District.

candidates.name: Mark Rice
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois' 8th Congressional District.

races.title: Illinois Comptroller
races.description: The Illinois Comptroller manages the state's finances, signs off on state payments, and provides financial oversight. Incumbent Susana Mendoza is not seeking re-election.

candidates.name: Margaret Croke
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois Comptroller.

candidates.name: Stephanie Kifowit
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois Comptroller.

candidates.name: Holly Kim
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois Comptroller.

candidates.name: Karina Villa
candidates.bio: Running in the Democratic primary for Illinois Comptroller.

candidates.name: Bryan Drew
candidates.bio: Running as the Republican candidate for Illinois Comptroller.

races.title: Illinois Treasurer
races.description: The Illinois Treasurer manages and invests the state's funds and oversees college savings and financial literacy programs.

candidates.name: Mike Frerichs
candidates.bio: Incumbent Illinois Treasurer seeking re-election. Frerichs has served as state treasurer since 2015, focusing on financial inclusion, college savings programs, and returning unclaimed property to Illinois residents.

candidates.name: Max Rice
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois Treasurer.

candidates.name: Max Solomon
candidates.bio: Running in the Republican primary for Illinois Treasurer.

races.title: Cook County Board President
races.description: The Cook County Board President oversees county government, the county budget, and county services for over 5 million residents. This race is only on the ballot for Cook County voters.

candidates.name: Toni Preckwinkle
candidates.bio: Cook County Board President since 2010, seeking a fifth term. Preckwinkle previously served as Chicago Alderman for the 4th Ward for 19 years. She has focused on criminal justice reform, fiscal responsibility, and expanding social services.

candidates.name: Brendan Reilly
candidates.bio: Longtime Chicago Alderman for the 42nd Ward (River North/Streeterville), challenging the incumbent Preckwinkle for the Democratic nomination.

races.title: Cook County Assessor
races.description: The Cook County Assessor determines the taxable value of all real property in the county — directly affecting property tax bills. This race is only on the ballot for Cook County voters.

candidates.name: Fritz Kaegi
candidates.bio: Cook County Assessor since 2018, seeking a third term. Kaegi has pushed to modernize the assessment process and eliminate disparities that historically over-assessed lower-value residential properties while under-assessing commercial properties.

candidates.name: Former employee (name TBD)
candidates.bio: A former employee of the Assessor's office is challenging incumbent Fritz Kaegi in the Democratic primary.
